Tag

Used to tag keywords and summarize the main content.(Minimum version: 24.9.0)

Import

Introduce the component to'app.json' or'index.json'.

"usingComponents": {
  "maui-tag": "@mauit/app/tag/index"
}

Sample Code

Basic Usage

The type attribute controls the color of the label. The default color is gray.


<maui-tag type="primary">label 1</maui-tag>
<maui-tag type="success">label 2</maui-tag>
<maui-tag type="danger">label 3</maui-tag>
<maui-tag type="warning">label 4</maui-tag>

Hollow Style

Set the'plain' property to a hollow style.


<maui-tag plain type="primary">label 1</maui-tag>
<maui-tag plain type="success">label 2</maui-tag>
<maui-tag plain type="danger">label 3</maui-tag>
<maui-tag plain type="warning">label 4</maui-tag>

Rounded Corner Style

Use'round' to set the rounded corner style.


<maui-tag round type="primary">label 1</maui-tag>
<maui-tag round type="success">label 2</maui-tag>
<maui-tag round type="danger">label 3</maui-tag>
<maui-tag round type="warning">label 4</maui-tag>

Marker Style

Use'mark' to set it to the mark style (semi-circular corner).


<maui-tag mark type="primary">label 1</maui-tag>
<maui-tag mark type="success">label 2</maui-tag>
<maui-tag mark type="danger">label 3</maui-tag>
<maui-tag mark type="warning">label 4</maui-tag>

Custom Colors


<maui-tag color="#f2826a">label 1</maui-tag>
<maui-tag color="#7232dd">label 2</maui-tag>
<maui-tag color="#7232dd" plain>label 3</maui-tag>
<maui-tag color="#ffe1e1" text-color="#ad0000">label 4</maui-tag>

Label Size


<maui-tag type="danger">label 1</maui-tag>
<maui-tag type="danger" size="medium">label 2</maui-tag>
<maui-tag type="danger" size="large">label 3</maui-tag>

Closeable Tags

Adding the'closeable' attribute indicates that the tag can be closed. When the tag is closed, the'close' event is triggered. In the'close' event, the logic for hiding the tag can be executed.


<maui-tag ma:if="{{ show.primary }}" closeable size="medium" type="primary" data-id="primary" bind:close="onClose">label 1</maui-tag>
<maui-tag ma:if="{{ show.success }}" closeable size="medium" type="success" data-id="success" bind:close="onClose">label 2</maui-tag>
Page({
   data: {
     show: {
       primary: true,
       success: true,
    },
  },
  onClose(event) {
   this.setData({
     [`show.${event.currentTarget.dataset.id}`]: false,
   });
  },
});

API

Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
Type Type. The value can be primary success danger warning String -
size Size. The value can be 'large' or 'medium' String -
plain Whether it is a hollow style Boolean false
round Whether it is a rounded corner style Boolean false
mark Whether it is marker style Boolean false
text-color Text color. The priority is higher than 'color' attribute. String white
closeable Whether it is closeable tag Boolean false

Slot

Name Description
- Customized Tag Display Content

Events

Event Name Description Callback Parameter
bind:close Triggered when a tag is closed. -
